# Becoming Minimalist

> > A resource for decluttering, minimalism, and intentional living that helps people own less and live more meaningfully.

Becoming Minimalist is a lifestyle platform focused on minimalism and home organization. The site offers courses, guidance, and resources for people seeking to simplify their lives and discover greater purpose through intentional living.

## Key Topics

- Minimalism
- Decluttering
- Home Organization
- Lifestyle Change
- Intentional Living
- Uncluttered Course
- Becoming Minimalist
- Cynthia Landon
- Online Programs
- Simplification

## Core Programs

- [Uncluttered: Own Less. Live More.](http://my.becomingminimalist.com/): Comprehensive decluttering and minimalist lifestyle course by Becoming Minimalist for transforming your home and discovering the life you want.
